title: New Zealand agricultural land use mapped with LUC, LUCAS and AgriBase data, 2022
credit: Clémence Vannier, Thomas A. Cochrane, Peyman Zawar-Reza and Larry Bellamy (2022), Land 11(12), 2334, Figure 1, CC BY 4.0
altText: Map of agricultural land use across New Zealand based in part on national land-use and land-use-capability data.
caption: A 2022 Canterbury-led map of New Zealand agricultural land use using LUCAS, Land Use Capability and AgriBase sources. It shows later spatial reuse of national land-assessment data, not an original 1970s NZLRI worksheet.
context: Figure 1 from Vannier and colleagues (2022). This is an actual geospatial output from New Zealand LUC and other agricultural data, created in 2022. It is not presented as a first-edition NZLRI worksheet, Land Use Capability sheet, or original LADEDA map. The primary figure caption explicitly identifies its datasets.
